entries.symptom: A JS-only cold-start timing looks fast but launch feels slow
entries.cause: JS timing misses most of the launch (process start, native init, bundle load)
entries.fix: Measure from process start to the first frame (a native process-start timestamp), over many launches

entries.symptom: The perf report check fails on cold starts recorded by an older build
entries.cause: The perf log survives app updates, so earlier builds were mixed in
entries.fix: Judge only the latest launches of the current build (the checker drops older entries)

entries.symptom: Cold start over budget on an older phone
entries.cause: The forced Intl polyfills and their locale data cost time and bundle size
entries.fix: Measure on a device before changing the polyfill policy; load only the locales the app ships

entries.symptom: A budget fails on a real device that passed on the simulator or emulator
entries.cause: Bundle, memory and draw budgets were first estimates from simulator probes
entries.fix: Re-baseline from device runs with a Gate-Change trailer; never loosen a budget to pass one run

entries.cause: Each content-size category maps to a font scale (large 1.0, accessibility-medium 1.786, accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large 3.571)
entries.fix: iOS: xcrun simctl ui <udid> content_size accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large; Android: adb -s <serial> shell settings put system font_scale 2.0; cap with maxFontSizeMultiplier where the design needs it

entries.symptom: VoiceOver swipe up or down (or the TalkBack adjust gesture) does nothing on a slider
entries.cause: accessibilityRole 'adjustable' without accessibilityActions increment and decrement
entries.fix: Add both actions and onAccessibilityAction; the a11y checker requires them

entries.symptom: Reduce Motion is on, but presses still sink and spring
entries.cause: No root motion config applies the reduce-motion setting to Reanimated's layout and spring animations
entries.fix: Wrap the app root in the motion config fed by useReduceMotion

entries.symptom: Smart Invert changes the colours of a canvas or photo
entries.cause: The view is inverted like other content
entries.fix: Set accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors on canvases and images (the palette has a dark variant)

entries.symptom: Canvas cells or small controls are below 44 pt (48 dp on Android) and nothing fails
entries.cause: The layout does not expose the smallest hit region
entries.fix: Expose the hit size from the layout and assert at least 44 pt / 48 dp in tests

entries.symptom: Text contrast drops below 4.5:1 during a pressed or held state
entries.cause: The state fill was never listed as a contrast pair
entries.fix: List every text-on-fill pair (states included) in contracts/contrast.json and fix the token, never the threshold

entries.symptom: TalkBack still reaches the screen behind a custom modal or dialog, while VoiceOver stays inside it
entries.fix: On Android hide the content behind the dialog with importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' while it is open (the shared dialog root does both)

entries.symptom: boxShadow or outline looks different on a device
entries.cause: Not verified on every platform version
entries.fix: Check in the first device build of each platform; keep a fallback shadow view
